subject: Vendr portal onboarding: minimal-proof acceptance & temporary credentialing
messages:
From: Amy Li <amy.li@astrascale.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@astrascale.com
Date: 2028-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendr portal onboarding: temporary credentials & minimal proof approach

Hi Sean / Marissa,

We're kicking off vendor onboarding on Vendr for our inference infra integration. We can get everything into the portal but wanted to ask whether Redwood accepts a "minimal-proof" bucket for the initial provisioning (SOC 2 summary + CAIQ delta + a handful of syslog samples) while we work toward full SIG. The ask from procurement is to get portal access and temporary creds so our infra team can validate S3 access and a basic telemetry export.

Questions:
- Do you allow a staged evidence path (minimal -> staged -> full) in Vendr?
- What's the TTL you typically set for temporary credentials?
- Who at Redwood will own the minimal proof triage?

We'd like to get access the week of 5/22 if possible. I'll also upload the CAIQ snapshot after our internal scrub; procurement will sign any required LOA/DocuSign.

Thanks,
Amy
Amy Li
Security Operations, AstraScale
amy.li@astrascale.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Li <amy.li@astrascale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding: temporary credentials & minimal proof approach

Amy — thanks for the clear note. Short answer: yes, we can support a staged evidence acceptance for portal provisioning but we need a tightly-scoped minimal checklist and a TTL for temporary creds. Here's the proposed playbook so we can move quickly without creating audit debt: 

1) Minimal-proof bundle (initial provisioning) — required at time of access:
   - SOC 2 attestation (PDF) or SOC 2 letter (redacted ok)
   - CAIQ snapshot highlighting changes (delta only)
   - 2 sample syslog files (anonymized) demonstrating telemetry export to your S3
   - Short statement of purpose & expected duration for temp access (1 page)

2) Temporary credential policy:
   - Default TTL: 7 days for staging work. Can be extended to 21 days with justification and CS approval.
   - Credentials issued via Vendr temporary role exchange; no long-lived keys granted.

3) Next steps & owners:
   - Marissa Cole will own evidence intake and initial QC (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — she will create the Vendr ticket and checklist.
   - Mina Haddad (portal ops) will provision the temporary role and set TTL once minimal-proof is accepted.

I've attached a quick minimal-proof checklist and a simple access matrix you can pre-fill (vendor_access_matrix.xlsx, minimal-proof-checklist.pdf). If that works, please upload the CAIQ snapshot and the SOC 2 doc to the Vendr portal and tag the upload ASTRA-145. Marissa — can you confirm the acceptance criteria and I will approve the temp role?

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Partnerships & GTM Security
Redwood Inference

Hi all — provisioning notes from portal ops: 

- We require SSO metadata (IdP XML or OIDC discovery URL) prior to creating any portal-admin link. If you want temporary programmatic creds instead, we'll create a short-lived role with restricted S3 put/get and CloudWatch-put permissions.
- Please include an explicit list of test buckets (ARNs) in the access_matrix spreadsheet so we scope permissions.
- Attachments we need from AstraScale to approve: SOC 2 letter (redacted ok), CAIQ delta, two syslog samples, and the completed access_matrix.

I'll provision in the staging tenant (vendr-staging.redwood.internal) once Marissa marks the ticket accepted. Expect provisioning within 4 business hours of approval.

Attachments: vendr-portal-ssometadata.txt (sample metadata + instructions)

Mina
Portal Operations — Redwood Inference
